paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.50% on average, with S&P 500 strongest (+1.15%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.04%). Brent crude changed +2.42% to 104.72. Gold changed +1.30% to 4,216.2998. Bitcoin changed -3.57% to 82,727.6562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.244%, a relative move of -0.63%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-5.99%) and ConocoPhillips (+5.80%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: Starbucks has explored takeover of Chipotle in restaurant megadeal (FT World). Western groups seek new investment opportunities despite chaos and heightened risks caused by conflict with Iran Geopolitics and trade: US announces sanctions campaign to ‘end’ ICC (FT World).
